summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Ooredoo Privileges Laravel dashboard. All core features working correctly including login, progressive loading, KPI display, and tab navigation.

issues: Retention Rate shows 1045% which seems unusually high - may need business logic review

Dashboard progressif loadTime: ~3000ms with all sections loaded successfully
KPI cards display real numeric values (Activated Subscriptions: 10,072, Active Subscriptions: 105,246, Retention Rate: 1045%, Conversion Rate: 4%)
